notes: v2.5.31. Build plan has a Departments view, on from this release, with Pipeline, Balance, Budget and Forecast, and it links both ways with the planner. eBOM edits are much faster on big builds: CATIA opens only the assembly you edit, a busy CATIA is a place in line instead of a refusal, and every CATIA wait says why. The rev time machine shows the whole build at any point, and the 3D viewer compares today's model with an earlier one. Rolling back is switched off in this update. Live updates sign in. Purchasing, requisitions, inventory, NCR and NIST fixes.
